title: 第11章 我要和他夜不归宿
slug: 狗哥你再舔女主我就和黄毛私奔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

赵楹月打车回了别墅。

这个点，天已经完全黑透，整座城市霓虹灯闪烁，一片繁荣景象。

赵家别墅灯火通明，赵楹月热的用手扇风，鼻尖都浸着汗珠。

方才哭过一场，脸上的妆容全花了，乍然一看，俨然狼狈又滑稽。

她才走进玄关，就听见一道凉凉的声音传来：“赵楹月，你给我过来。”

是她哥，赵随野。

“哥。”赵楹月老实走过去，站在离男人一米远的地方。

头顶的光线照下来，衬得那张花脸更是乱七八槽，完全看不出原本的漂亮样。

赵随野眉心一跳，握紧拳头。

“又去找那个死黄毛鬼混了？”

他很想装出一副嗤之以鼻的样子，但心底的那股火，促使他咬牙切齿的吐出每一个字。

尤其是看见赵楹月这副模样，心中的怒火，更是‘噌噌噌’往外冒。

怒火中烧到了极致。

“哥，他不是死黄毛，”赵楹月认真纠正他，“他是我的心肝宝。”

赵随野：“……”

神特么心肝宝！

拳头捏的咯吱响，丝毫不夸张，如果真有个黄毛出现在他面前，他一定揍得他妈都不认识！

忍了又忍，压了又压。

终于，赵随野让自己勉强心平气和下来。

他试图和赵楹月讲道理：“月月，不是哥哥不让你去找他，你是女孩子，要矜持。”

“心肝宝不喜欢矜持的女孩子，他喜欢奔放的女人！”赵楹月用一本正经的表情，语出惊人。

赵随野从来没有像现在一样，庆幸自己没有任何疾病。

不然他能立刻表演什么叫原地升天！

“赵楹月——”

“随野，汤煲好了，”孟以棠端着汤碗从厨房出来，打断了赵随野后面的话，“你快来尝尝。”

将碗放到桌上，孟以棠这才看见赵楹月。

惊讶的微睁眼，“楹月？你回来啦，正好，快来一起喝点汤。”

鸡汤在砂锅里慢熬了三四个小时，清亮油润，香气扑鼻。

“好啊。”

赵楹月爽快答应，倒打了孟以棠一个猝不及防。

她以为赵楹月会拒绝……

掩去眼底的神色，孟以棠又转身回厨房多拿了一副碗筷出来。

Page (1/3)

Zhao Yingyue took a taxi back to the villa.

At this point, the sky was completely dark, and the whole city was filled with neon lights and a prosperous scene.

The Zhao family villa was brightly lit, and Zhao Yingyue was fanning her hands hotly, and the tip of her nose was soaked with sweat.

He had just cried a lot, and his makeup was all stained. At first glance, he looked embarrassed and funny.

She had just walked into the entrance hall when she heard a cool voice: "Zhao Yingyue, come here."

It's her brother, Zhao Suiye.

"Brother." Zhao Yingyue walked over honestly and stood one meter away from the man.

The light from the top of her head shone down, making her painted face even more messy, and her original beauty could not be seen at all.

Zhao Suiye's eyebrows jumped and he clenched his fists.

"Going to hang out with that damn yellow guy again?"

He wanted to pretend to be scornful, but the fire in his heart prompted him to grit his teeth and spit out every word.

Especially when he saw Zhao Yingyue's appearance, the anger in his heart burst out even more.

Furious to the extreme.

"Brother, he is not a deadbeat," Zhao Yingyue corrected him seriously, "He is my darling."

Zhao Suiye: "..."

God is such a sweetheart!

The clenching sound of his fists was no exaggeration. If a yellow-haired man really appeared in front of him, he would beat him so hard that he wouldn't even recognize him!

I endured it again and again, and I suppressed it again and again.

Finally, Zhao Suiye forced himself to calm down.

He tried to reason with Zhao Yingyue: "Yueyue, it's not that my brother won't let you go to him. You are a girl, so you have to be reserved."

"The sweetheart doesn't like reserved girls, he likes unrestrained women!" Zhao Yingyue said with a serious expression, which was shocking.

Zhao Suiye has never been as grateful as he is now that he does not have any disease.

Otherwise, he can immediately perform what it means to ascend to heaven on the spot!

"Zhao Yingyue——"

"Suiye, the soup is ready," Meng Yitang came out of the kitchen with a soup bowl and interrupted Zhao Suiye's words, "Come and have a taste."

Putting the bowl on the table, Meng Yitang saw Zhao Yingyue.

She opened her eyes slightly in surprise, "Yingyue? You're back. Just in time. Come and have some soup together."

The chicken soup has been simmered slowly in the casserole for three or four hours, making it clear, oily and fragrant.

"Okay."

Zhao Yingyue readily agreed and caught Meng Yitang off guard.

She thought Zhao Yingyue would refuse...

Covering the look in his eyes, Meng Yitang turned back to the kitchen and took out an extra pair of dishes and chopsticks.
